entities.summary: Mahmud al-Muntasir was a Libyan politician and statesman who served as the first Prime minister of Libya from March 29, 1951 to February 19, 1954, and again from January 20, 1964 to March 20, 1965. He was also the Minister of Foreign Affairs during his first term.
